name: Marris Stead
summary: In the southwestern Eastern Plaguelands, Nathanos Blightcaller holds Marris Stead. Once a peaceful Lordaeron homestead, the ridge now shelters his lonely, heavily defended redoubt.

sections.title: A Ranger's Ruined Home
sections.body: Nathanos Marris once lived at Marris Stead. Before the Third War, the renowned human marksman became the only human ranger lord admitted into the Farstriders. After Stratholme fell, the Scourge swept through Lordaeron. Ramstein the Gorger cornered and killed Nathanos at his own home. The Lich King raised him as a mindless thrall, until Sylvanas Windrunner freed him. Nathanos then joined the Forsaken.

sections.title: The Champion's Bastion
sections.body: Nathanos Blightcaller returned to his ancestral farmstead with his pack of vicious blighthounds. Following the Banshee Queen's orders, he directs strikes across the Plaguelands against the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade. Stormwind's intelligence service also turned its attention to the farm. SI:7 operatives sent to investigate Forsaken activity there were slaughtered. The Alliance learned Nathanos had become undead and placed a heavy bounty on his head.

faq.answer: Nathanos Blightcaller lives at Marris Stead with his pack of blighthounds. As Champion of the Banshee Queen, he commands on the front lines.
During the Third War, the Scourge devastated Lordaeron and raised many victims as undead. Nathanos's own history and release from Scourge control are told in the protected section.

faq.q: Why is the Alliance interested in this farm?
faq.answer: SI:7 spymaster Mathias Shaw received disturbing reports of unusual Forsaken activity and sent agents to investigate. When only one returned, more investigators went to discover what had happened to the others.

angles.text: SI:7's missing agents make this Forsaken-held homestead a troubling focus for Alliance investigators in the Plaguelands.
For the Forsaken and their Horde allies, the stead is a heavily defended base for waging war against the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade.
